card.name: Just before a person's name or title
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small linking words right before a person's name or role is given, such as a colon, comma, 'as' or 'and' leading into a name or office title. Also fires on a few word-internal pieces.

modes.label: Before a named person
modes.description: A colon, comma or 'and' sits just ahead of a person's name or office holder.
modes.example: The officers for 1916 are<<: >>President George W. Chase, Jr.

modes.label: Before a role
modes.description: The word 'as' or 'first' comes before a job title like Chargé d'Affaires or mayor.
modes.example: Solomon Juneau was elected the<< first>> mayor.

modes.label: Inside a word
modes.description: A word piece partway through a longer word such as a grass or drug metabolite name.

card.writes: It leans toward role words like Manager and manager, so it expects a title or position next.
card.plain: It fires at the small break just before a person's name or job title.
